description: This excitation system supplies power through a transformer from the generator terminals and its regulated by a controlled rectifier (via thyristors). Parameters of IEEE Std 421.5 Type ST1A Excitacion System. ESST1A in PSSE and PSLF

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

UEL_flags.description: Code input for Underexcitization limiter (UEL) entry

PSS_flags.description: Code input for Power System Stabilizer (PSS) or (VOS) entry

Tr.description: Regulator input filter time constant. Units: s.

Tc.description: First regulator numerator (lead) time constant. Units: s.

Tb.description: First regulator denominator (lag) time constant. Units: s.

Tc1.description: Second regulator numerator (lead) time constant. Units: s.

Tb1.description: Second regulator denominator (lag) time constant. Units: s.

Ta.description: Voltage regulator time constant. Units: s.

Kc.description: Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance

Tf.description: Rate feedback time constant. Units: s.
